article.story: EVANSVILLE, Ind. -- — Kyle Waltz helped lead Miami (Ohio) past Evansville on Saturday with 19 points off of the bench in an 86-78 victory. Waltz shot 6 of 7 from the field, including 3 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 4 for 4 from the line for the RedHawks (3-0). Stevie Elam scored 18 points and added seven rebounds. Almar Atlason shot 6 for 11, including 5 for 9 from beyond the arc to finish with 17 points. Bryce Quinet finished with 30 points and eight assists for the Purple Aces (2-2). Evansville also got 26 points and six assists from A.J. Casey. Waltz scored 11 points in the first half and Miami went into the break trailing 45-43. Miami (OH) pulled off the victory after a 15-2 second-half run erased a two-point deficit and gave them the lead at 58-47 with 16:15 left in the half. Elam scored 11 second-half points. Up next Miami next plays Wednesday against Defiance at home. Evansville will host Le Moyne on Tuesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
